Rhyperior

Ground Rock

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Rhyperior is a Ground/Rock-type Drill Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 2.4 m tall and weighs 282.8 kg. It evolves from Rhydon. Its highest base stat is Attack (140), with a base stat total of 535.
